stock_analysis_curriculum.summary: A top-down approach curriculum for analyzing and selecting US stocks (NYSE/NASDAQ). Covers 7 chapters: Model Overview, Macro Analysis, Sector Analysis, Stock Scanning, Fundamental Analysis, Options Analysis, and Integrated Practice Process.

top_down_approach_overview.summary: The top-down approach starts from macroeconomic analysis and narrows down to individual stocks via a 5-floor pyramid: risk assessment, macro analysis, sector identification, fundamental evaluation, and entry point selection.

macro_analysis.summary: Evaluates macroeconomic environment using GDP, CPI/inflation, Fed Funds rate, Non-Farm Payroll, ISM Manufacturing, Consumer Confidence, and Yield Curve. Also identifies pain points (geopolitical, banking crises, FX) and index support/resistance via Fibonacci, MA50/200.

economic_indicators.summary: Key macro indicators: GDP growth, CPI/inflation, Non-Farm Payroll, ISM Manufacturing (>50 = expansion), Consumer Confidence, and Yield Curve (inverted = recession warning).

vix_analysis.summary: VIX measures market fear: <15 strong buy, 15-20 normal, 20-30 defensive shift, >30 potential reversal, >40 crisis/panic. VIX term structure contango reversal signals immediate fear.

sector_analysis.summary: 40-60% of stock performance is sector-driven. Uses RRG charts to classify sectors: Leading (buy), Weakening (monitor/exit), Lagging (avoid), Improving (early entry). Confirms with sector ETF outperforming SPY, above MA50/MA200, and >60% of stocks above MA50.

rrg_charts.summary: Relative Rotation Graph plots sector momentum in 4 quadrants: Leading (buy), Weakening (monitor/exit), Lagging (avoid), Improving (early opportunity). Confirmed by ETF breakouts with volume and 50/200 MA.

macro_themes.summary: Long-term structural investment themes: AI/Cloud (XLK), high interest rates/financials (XLF), energy restructuring (XLE + cleantech), aging population/healthcare (XLV), onshoring/industrials (XLI), consumer recovery (XLY), defensives (XLU, XLP, GLD).

scan_and_filter_stocks.summary: Stock screening reduces thousands of stocks to 10-20 candidates using Barchart, IV Percentile, and Finviz composite screener with fundamental+technical filters.

stock_screening_tools.summary: Barchart: 100% Buy, MA filters, volume 1.5x. IV%: <25 buy options, 25-50 flexible, >50 sell options. Finviz: composite screener. Filters: price >$10, USA, week +2%, SMA20>SMA50, volume >500K/day.

watchlist_management.summary: 4 watchlists: Ready to Trade (analyzed, awaiting entry), On Radar (not yet eligible), Earnings Watch (upcoming earnings/IV play), Sector Rotation (improving sectors, early entry). Each limited to 15-20 stocks.

fundamental_analysis.summary: Valuation methods: P/E vs industry average, Forward P/E (<20 for growth), PEG ratio (<1 = undervalued), Price/FCF (<25), DCF, EV/EBITDA (<10-12x). 'Broke near support' signal: good fundamentals + near support + low-volume decline + negative catalyst priced in + high IV%.

valuation_methods.summary: P/E vs industry average, Forward P/E <20 for growth stocks, PEG <1 = undervalued, P/FCF <25, DCF intrinsic value, EV/EBITDA <10-12x. Best opportunities: good fundamentals near support with negative catalyst already priced in.

volatility_analysis.summary: Historical vs implied volatility. Avoid short-term options 2-3 weeks before earnings. Post-earnings IV drops 30-60% (IV crush). Check typical post-earnings move size.

scan_strike_and_probability.summary: Options entry using Delta (0.15-0.30 for selling, >=0.40 for buying) and POP thresholds. Capital: <=5% per position, <=20% per sector, 30-45 DTE. Stop loss at 2x premium; take profit at 50% max profit.

delta_and_options_greeks.summary: Delta: 0.70-0.80 deep ITM; 0.50 ATM; 0.30-0.40 slight OTM; 0.15-0.25 OTM low win rate; <0.15 far OTM. Golden rule: sell at delta 0.15-0.30, buy at delta >=0.40.

probability_of_profit.summary: POP thresholds: Short Put/CSP >70%, Bull Put Spread >65%, Iron Condor >60%, Covered Call >75%, Long Call/Put uses R/R >=2:1. Strike placed 5-10% below support. POP >68% required for statistical significance.

capital_and_risk_management.summary: Position sizing <=5% per trade, sector <=20%, max 3-4 open positions. 30-45 DTE for theta. Stop loss at 2x premium. Take profit at 50% max profit. Fair value check before assignment.

integrated_practice_process.summary: Weekly routine: weekend Fed/economic review + RRG sector check, early week VIX + S&P futures check + watchlist update, during week earnings/sector news + position management. 7-step pre-trade checklist: VIX<25, leading sector, top scan, reasonable fundamentals, IV% fit, POP>68% with strike below support, position <5% with stop loss.

weekly_routine.summary: Weekend: Fed reports, sector news, RRG. Early week: VIX, S&P futures, watchlist update. Mid-week: earnings calendar. Weekend: review performance, close at 50% profit.

pre_trade_checklist.summary: 7 steps: (1) VIX<25, (2) Sector leading/improving, (3) Top Barchart/Finviz, (4) P/E, EPS, debt, (5) IV% fit, (6) POP>68% strike below support, (7) position <5% with stop loss.

nvda_case_study.summary: NVDA March 2025: 100% Buy, IV% 55%, Forward P/E 35x, EPS +120% YoY, FCF positive, testing MA50. Sell Put $700 (below $720 support), Delta 0.25, POP 75%, DTE 38, premium $450, gain target $225.

vocabulary.summary: Key terms: VIX, IV, Delta, POP, DTE, Theta, RRG, IV Crush, Support/Resistance, Short Put, Iron Condor, Cash Secured Put, Covered Call.

top-down_approach_model.summary: 5-floor pyramid: Risk Assessment → Macro Analysis → Sector Identification → Stock Evaluation → Entry Point Selection. Supported by tools including VIX, RRG charts, Finviz, IV percentile, and options probability metrics.

vix.summary: CBOE Volatility Index measuring 30-day S&P 500 volatility. Levels: <15 low risk/buy, 15-20 caution, 20-30 defensive, >30 high fear/reversal possible, >40 crisis/sell puts. VIX Term Structure contango reversals signal immediate fear.

rrg_chart.summary: Relative Rotation Graph with 4 quadrants: Leading (strong momentum), Weakening (losing momentum), Lagging (weak), Improving (recovering). Used to identify sector rotation and early opportunities.

stock_scanning_and_filtering.summary: Narrows thousands of stocks to 10-20 candidates using Barchart (100% Buy, 20MA>50MA, volume >1.5x avg, Large Cap >$10B), IV Percentile (<25 buy, >50 sell), and Finviz screener. Additional filters: price >$10, US-based, weekly gain >2%, SMA20>SMA50, volume >500K/day.

iv_percentile.summary: Implied Volatility Percentile vs 1-year history. <25% = cheap options (buy calls/puts), 25-50% = neutral/flexible, >50% = expensive options (sell), >75% = sell strongest premium with high event risk.

options_analysis.summary: Covers historical vs implied volatility, IV crush risk near earnings (avoid long options 2-3 weeks before). Delta ranges for strike selection: sell at 0.15-0.30, buy at ≥0.40. POP targets: Short Put >70%, Bull Put Spread >65%, Iron Condor >60%, Covered Call >75%. Execution: 30-45 DTE, ≤5% portfolio per trade, stop loss at 2x premium, take profit at 50% max gain.

delta_and_strike_selection.summary: Delta measures option sensitivity per $1 stock move. Ranges: 0.70-0.80 deep ITM, 0.50 ATM, 0.30-0.40 slight OTM (balanced), 0.15-0.25 OTM (high leverage), <0.15 far OTM (lottery). Golden rule: sell at delta 0.15-0.30, buy at delta ≥0.40.

position_sizing_and_risk_management.summary: Rules: POP >68% required, optimal DTE 30-45 days for Theta decay. Position sizing: ≤5% portfolio per trade, ≤20% in one sector, max 3-4 open positions for beginners. Stop loss at 2x premium paid; take profit at 50% of max gain.
